row.notes: Reads the card instance *card_ref (+0xc count/int, +0x18 definition, +0x38 time, +0x34 state) and its definition (+0x10 type, +0x11 category, +0x12 rarity, +0x230 theme id, +0x234 definition id, +0x260 item list) and writes the VM nodes: s32 at +0x358 and +0x378, type/category strings at +0x3b0/+0x3d0, rarity text +0x48 and icon path "#overrides.f1cg.cards.rarity_icon.%s" at +0x88, owned flag +0x418 from FUN_1427713a0, per-item bools at +0x138/+0x158/+0x178 with refs at +0xd0/+0xf0/+0x110. It finds the row in "f1cg_theme_definitions" whose "id" equals the theme id and links bg_name, frame_name, image_array, vfx_name, style_name at +0x1b8..+0x230, then binds "#f1cg_definitions.%d" at +0x258 and copies card_name (+0x298) and card_date (+0x278); if +0x758 is set it also formats the acquire date into +0x740. Caller 0x14277fef0: populates the full card view and then handles definition type 7 extras; callers 0x1427859a0 and 0x142785b70: small callbacks that copy the shared card ref and call this. Good hook to change what a F1 World collectible card shows. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
